name: Critiquing

metrics.description: Share of cases whose answer was right after the critique. The suite's headline.
Share of candidate answers that were already right — the corpus's own composition, reported so uplift can be read.
Post-correction accuracy minus original accuracy, measured per case so the mean is the difference of the means.
Share of already-correct answers the critic made incorrect. A headline metric, not a footnote.
Share of genuinely wrong answers the critic flagged. Absent on cases whose candidate was right.
Share of flagged answers that were genuinely wrong. Absent for a case the critic did not flag.
Share of already-correct answers the critic flagged anyway.
Share of offered corrections that were right. Absent where no correction was offered.

description: Question, candidate answer and known correctness. Half the candidates are already right, which is what makes the hallucinated-criticism and regression rates measurable rather than assumed.
